project.name: phase5d-frozen-zk
project.description:
Phase 5d migrates zkwebui/WEB-INF/src and the packaged modules' src/main/java/ui/zk trees to ZK CE 10.3.0.1-jakarta. Those sources can no longer be compiled against the ZK 3.6 jars in zkwebui/WEB-INF/lib, so the Ant reactor no longer builds the legacy web artifacts from the working tree.
Instead the legacy webui.war and the legacy ZK package jars are materialized from the exact commit the Phase 5b oracle was frozen at (contracts/legacy-web-v1/capture-environment.tsv:source_commit) in an isolated, throwaway Git worktree. The reactor, the installer, and the release archives then consume those frozen artifacts unchanged, so the shipped legacy product still matches the frozen Phase 5b pins entry for entry while no migrated source is ever compiled against ZK 3.6.
Rollback is the frozen artifact itself: it is rebuilt from a named commit, not from a dual source tree.

target.name: phase5d.materialize-frozen-zk
target.description: Materializes the frozen legacy webui.war and ZK package jars

Phase 5d: no frozen ZK package jars were materialized in ${phase5d.frozen.zkpackages}
